Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000.

Field.Name: Symbol

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the order. Please refer to the Data Types section for more clarification.

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: Corresponds to TimeInForce (59) in Nasdaq FIX

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Y = visible N = hidden A = attributable

Field.Name: Capacity

Field.Name: CrossType

Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: The Replace Order Message allows you to alter most of the attributes of an order in a single message. This is more efficient than canceling an existing order and immediately succeeding it with a new order. Replacing an order always gives it a new timestamp for its time priority on the book. If you wish you simply partially cancel an order and retain its time priority, send a Cancel Order Message instead.

Field.Name: OrigUserRefNum
Field.Description: This must be filled out with the Order UserRefNum sent on the Enter Order Message or last Replace Order Message.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: As described above in Data Types. The replacement Order UserRefNum must be unique and strictly increasing for each OUCH account.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares liable, inclusive of previous executions and Self Match Prevention decremented shares on this order chain. Must be greater than zero and less than 1,000,000.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the replacement order.

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: Corresponds to TimeInForce (59) in Nasdaq FIX

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Y = visible N = hidden A = attributable

Field.Name: InterMarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: Y = eligible N = not eligible

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Customer order identifier for replacement order

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: Replace Order Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: The Cancel Order Message is used to request that an order be canceled or reduced. In the Cancel Order Message, you must specify the new 'intended order size' for the order. The 'intended order size' is the maximum number of shares that can be executed in total after the cancel is applied.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The Order UserRefNum as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: This is the new intended order size. This limits the maximum number of shares that can potentially be executed in total after the cancel is applied. Entering a zero here will cancel any remaining open shares on this order.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order Message is used to request modifications that will not affect order priority on the book unless the share amount is increased. Since priority of the order does not change (exception noted), allowed modifications are restricted to only the ones specified in the message details below.

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The Order UserRefNum as was originally transmitted in an Enter Order Message

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The new side to be associated with the order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: This is the new intended order size. This limits the maximum number of shares that can potentially be executed in total after the cancel is applied. Entering a zero here will cancel any remaining open shares on this order.

Message.Name: Account Query Message
Message.Description: The Account Query Request message can be used when recovering state to request the next available UserRefNum that can be used for identifying new transactions.

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field. The Appendage Length and Optional Appendage fields are optional on this message type.

Field.Name: Account Query Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Replaced Message
Message.Description: This message acknowledges the receipt and acceptance of a valid Replace Order Message. The data fields from the Replace Order Message are echoed back in this message. Note that the accepted values may differ from the entered values for some fields. You will receive one and only one of these two for each replacement.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Expressed as nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: OrigUserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the order being replaced

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the replacement order, as entered

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side indicator as entered on the original order in the chain

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares outstanding

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol as entered

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The accepted price of the replacement. Please note that the accepted price could potentially be different than the entered price if the order was re-priced by NASDAQ on entry. The accepted price will always be better than or equal to the entered.

Field.Name: Time In Force
Field.Description: The accepted Time in Force of the replacement. Please note that the accepted Time in Force may potentially be different than the entered Time in Force. The accepted Time in Force will always be equal to or shorter in scope than the entered Time in Force

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: The accepted display type for the order.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The day-unique Order Reference Number assigned by NASDAQ to this order

Field.Name: Capacity
Field.Description: The capacity specified on the order

Field.Name: InterMarket Sweep Eligibility
Field.Description: Y = eligible N = not eligible

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: The cross type as entered

Field.Name: Order State
Field.Description: L = Order Live D = Order Dead

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Customer order identifier for replacement order

Field.Name: Appendage Length
Field.Description: The length of the remaining Optional Appendage field.

Field.Name: Replaced Message Appendage
Field.Description: The available options supported on this message

Message.Name: Canceled Message
Message.Description: A Canceled Message informs you that an order has been reduced or canceled. This could be acknowledging a Cancel Order Message, or it could be the result of the order timing out or being canceled automatically.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Expressed as nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the order being (partially) canceled

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The number of shares being decremented from the order. This number is incremental, not cumulative

Field.Name: Cancel Order Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or canceled.

Message.Name: AIQ Canceled Message
Message.Description: AIQ Canceled Message

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Expressed as nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: UserRefNum
Field.Description: The UserRefNum of the order being reduced

Field.Name: Decrement Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares just decremented from the order. This number is incremental, not cumulative.

Field.Name: Order Cancel Reason
Field.Description: Reason the order was reduced or canceled. For an AIQ Cancel message, this value will always be 'Q'.

Field.Name: Quantity Prevented From Trading
Field.Description: Shares that would have executed if the trade would have occurred.

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: Price at which the trade would have occurred

Field.Name: Liquidity Flag
Field.Description: Liquidity flag the order would have received.

Field.Description: Symbol to mass cancel orders on. Optional, space filled if not specified

Field.Name: Appendage Length

Optional.Name: SecondaryOrdRefNum
Optional.Description: An alternative order reference number used when publishing the order on the Nasdaq market data feeds (identifying, for example, the displayed portion of a reserve order)

Optional.Name: Firm
Optional.Description: This field should contain all caps. Firm identifier for the order entry firm. One logical OUCH account can potentially enter orders for multiple firms in a Service Bureau configuration. If this field is blank-filled, the default firm for the OUCH account will be used.

Optional.Name: MinQty
Optional.Description: MinQty must be a round lot.

Optional.Name: CustomerType
Optional.Description: R = Retail Designated Order N = Not Retail Designated (default)

Optional.Name: MaxFloor
Optional.Description: Represents the portion of your order that you wish to have displayed.

Optional.Name: PriceType
Optional.Description: L = limit (default) P = market peg M = midpoint peg R = primary peg Q = market maker peg m = midpoint

Optional.Name: PegOffset
Optional.Description: Offset amount for the pegged value.

Optional.Name: DiscretionPrice
Optional.Description: Discretion price for Discretionary Order.

Optional.Name: DiscretionPegType
Optional.Description: L = limit (default) P = market peg M = midpoint peg R = primary peg

Optional.Name: DiscretionPegOffset
Optional.Description: Offset amount for the pegged value of the Discretionary Price.

Optional.Name: PostOnly
Optional.Description: P = Post Only (Mid-point Post Only not available on BX) N = No (default)

Optional.Name: RandomReserves
Optional.Description: Shares to do random reserve with.

Optional.Name: Route
Optional.Description: Route destination

Optional.Name: ExpireTime
Optional.Description: Seconds to live. Must be less than 86400 (number of seconds in a day)

Optional.Name: TradeNow
Optional.Description: Y = yes N = no (default)

Optional.Name: HandleInst
Optional.Description: I = imbalance only (CrossType O and C) O = retail order type 1 (CrossType R) T = retail order type 2 (CrossType R) Q = retail price improvement (CrossType R) B = Extended Life + Continuous (CrossType E) D = Direct Listing Capital Raise (CrossType H)

Optional.Name: BBO Weight Indicator
Optional.Description: '0' = 0-0.2% '1' = 0.2%-1% '2' = 1%-2% '3' = greater than 2% space = unspecified (default) 'S' = Sets the QBBO while joining the NBBO 'N' = Improves the NBBO upon entry

Optional.Name: Reference Price
Optional.Description: Used in the Order Executed Message only. The reference price associated with the execution; provided with an associated Reference Price Type

Optional.Name: Reference Price Type
Optional.Description: Used in the Order Executed Message only. I = Intraday Indicative Value

Optional.Name: Display Quantity
Optional.Description: Used in the Order Restated Message only. Represents an update of an order's displayed quantity (i.e. an order with reserves).

Optional.Name: Display Price
Optional.Description: Used in the Order Restated Message only. Represents an update of an order's displayed price.

Optional.Name: Group ID
Optional.Description: Customer Group ID – identifies specific entity within customer firm

Optional.Name: UserRefIdx
Optional.Description: User Reference Index – identifies the channel within the given port

Optional.Name: Side
Optional.Description: Side of the orders to cancel
